intro_text.en: Start with a practical situation,draw the model,and solve one step at a time.
intro_text.gu: Practical પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂ કરીએ,model દોરીએ અને એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલીએ.

h.en: 7.1.1 Less effort does not mean free energy
h.gu: 7.1.1 ઓછો Effort એટલે Free Energy નહિ

body.en:
Start with a situation

A lifting machine lets a person move a heavy load with a smaller effort, but the effort usually travels farther and friction consumes energy.

Definition

A simple lifting machine transmits effort P to lift load W through a kinematic arrangement. Mechanical advantage MA=W/P; velocity ratio VR=effort distance/load distance.

Understand the reason

For a steady lifting step with the stated geometry, efficiency eta=useful output/input=(W/P)/VR=MA/VR.

Example / application

A largeVR can reduce effort while increasing required effort travel.

Remember / avoid this mistake

MA andVR are dimensionless; eta can be a fraction or percent, but label it correctly.
body.gu:
એક પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત કરીએ

Lifting machine ભારે loadને ઓછા effortથી ખસેડે,પણ effort સામાન્ય રીતે વધુ distance જાય અને friction energy વાપરે.

ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Simple lifting machine kinematic arrangementથી effort P વડે load W ઊંચકે.Mechanical advantage MA=W/P;velocity ratio VR=effort distance/load distance.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated geometryના steady lifting stepમાં efficiency eta=useful output/input=(W/P)/VR=MA/VR.

ઉદાહરણ / ઉપયોગ

મોટો VR effort ઘટાડે,પણ effort travel વધારે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

MA,VR dimensionless છે;eta fraction કે percent હોઈ શકે,સાચું label કરો.

body.en:
Given

A machine liftsW1000 N withP100 N; effort moves2m while load rises.1m.

Stepwise solution

  1. MA=1000/100=10; VR=2/.1=20
  2. eta=10/20=.5=50%
  3. Input work=100×2=200 J; output=1000×.1=100 J; loss100 J

Remember / avoid this mistake

This steady work model excludes changes in stored kinetic/potential energy of moving machine parts unless accounted for.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Machine W1000Nને P100Nથી ઊંચકે;effort2m જાય,load.1m ઊંચે જાય.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. MA=1000/100=10;VR=2/.1=20
  2. eta=10/20=.5=50%
  3. Input work=100×2=200J;output=1000×.1=100J;loss100J

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ steady work modelમાં machine partsની stored kinetic/potential energy changes અલગ account ન કરીએ તો excluded છે.

h.en: 7.1.3 Law of machine and limiting performance
h.gu: 7.1.3 Law of Machine અને Limiting Performance

body.en:
Definition

An empirical law over a validated load range isP=mW+C; m is the effort-load slope, C is the fitted no-load effort intercept.

MA=W/(mW+C); eta=W/[VR(mW+C)].For positive constantm and fixed VR, asW grows, the model limits areMAmax=1/m, etamax=1/(mVR).

Remember / avoid this mistake

These limiting values do not authorise unlimited loading. The empirical straight line may fail outside measured range and the rated safe load always controls.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Validated load rangeમાં empirical law P=mW+C છે;m effort-load slope,C fitted no-load effort intercept છે.

MA=W/(mW+C);eta=W/[VR(mW+C)].Positive constant m,fixed VRમાં W વધે ત્યારે model limits MAmax=1/m,etamax=1/(mVR) છે.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Limiting values unlimited loadingની permission નથી.Measured rangeની બહાર empirical line ખોટી પડે; rated safe load માનવો જ પડે.

h.en: 7.1.4 Fit a law from two illustrative points

body.en:
Given

W500 N requires P60 N; W1000 N requires P100 N; VR20.

Stepwise solution

  1. m=(100−60)/(1000−500)=.08; C=60−.08×500=20 N
  2. P=.08W+20; atW750 N, P80 N
  3. MA=750/80=9.375; eta=9.375/20=.46875=46.875%
  4. Model MAmax=12.5; etamax=.625=62.5%

Remember / avoid this mistake

Two points define a teaching line, not a robust experimental fit; real testing needs repeated points and uncertainty/residual review.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

W500N માટે P60N;W1000N માટે P100N;VR20.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. m=(100−60)/(1000−500)=.08;C=60−.08×500=20N
  2. P=.08W+20;atW750N,P80N
  3. MA=750/80=9.375;eta=9.375/20=.46875=46.875%
  4. Model MAmax=12.5;etamax=.625=62.5%

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

બે points teaching line આપે,robust experimental fit નહિ;real testingમાં repeated points,uncertainty,residual review જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

A reversible machine can be driven backward by its load when effort is removed under the stated conditions. A self-locking/irreversible machine does not back-drive under those conditions.

Understand the reason

The elementary constant-friction work model gives the familiar boundary eta50%:above it the model predicts reversibility, below it self-locking. Real mechanisms require geometry/friction/back-driving checks and a brake/safety assessment.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Do not assume eta≤50% guarantees safe load holding under vibration, wear, lubrication or impact. Use rated brakes/locks; never stand beneath a suspended load.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Effort દૂર કરીએ ત્યારે stated conditionsમાં loadથી પાછળ ચાલે તે reversible machine.Self-locking/irreversibleમાં એ conditionsમાં back-drive ન થાય.

હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Elementary constant-friction work modelમાં familiar boundary eta50% છે:ઉપર model reversibility,નીચે self-locking કહે.Real mechanismsમાં geometry/friction/back-driving checks,brake/safety assessment જોઈએ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

eta≤50% એટલે vibration,wear,lubrication,impactમાં safe holdingની guarantee નહિ.Rated brakes/locks લો;suspended load નીચે ન રહો.

body.en:
Definition

A large effort wheel of radius R drives a smaller load axle of radiusr rigidly on the same axis.

Construction:parts and purpose

Effort wheel and handle/rope provide the input radius R.

A smaller axle winds the load rope at effective radiusr.

A common shaft and bearings connect/support the rotation.

Rated rope, hook and holding device support safe lifting.

Working:sequence and reason

Apply authorised effort at the wheel circumference.

One revolution moves effort through2piR and load through2pir.

CalculateVR=R/r and compare measured MA withVR.

Use the specified holding/lowering device; do not rely on friction alone.

Remember / avoid this mistake

Use effective rope radii; layers of wound rope change the geometry. R200 mm, r25 mm gives VR8.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Radius Rનું મોટું effort wheel same axisના radius rના નાના load axleને rigidly ચલાવે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Effort wheel,handle/rope input radius R આપે.

નાનો axle effective radius r પર load rope વાળે.

Common shaft,bearings rotation જોડે/ટેકો આપે.

Rated rope,hook,holding device safe lifting આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Wheel circumference પર authorised effort આપો.

એક revolutionમાં effort2piR,load2pir જાય.

VR=R/r ગણો,measured MA સાથે સરખાવો.

Specified holding/lowering device લો;ફક્ત friction પર ભરોસો નહિ.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Effective rope radii લો;rope layers geometry બદલે.R200mm,r25mm માટે VR8.

body.en:
Definition

Two rigidly connected unequal axle radii wind/unwind opposite rope ends around a movable load pulley.

Construction:parts and purpose

An effort wheel has radius R.

Two common-shaft drums have radiir1>r2.

Oppositely wound rope ends run to the load pulley.

A movable pulley, hook and rated restraints carry the load.

Working:sequence and reason

One turn takes up2pi r1 at one drum and releases2pi r2 at the other.

Net rope shortening=2pi(r1−r2); two supporting parts share the load rise.

Load rise per turn=pi(r1−r2), soVR=2R/(r1−r2).

Measure effort/load under a supervised rated test and use the designated holding system.

Remember / avoid this mistake

R=200 mm, r1=50 mm, r2=40 mm in this example:VR40. Use clear radius subscripts, not three ambiguous numbers.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Rigidly connected unequal axle radii movable load pulleyની opposite rope endsને wind/unwind કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Effort wheelનો radius R છે.

Common-shaft બે drumsના radii r1>r2 છે.

Oppositely wound rope ends load pulley સુધી જાય.

Movable pulley,hook,rated restraints load લે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

એક turnમાં એક drum2pi r1 વાળે,બીજો2pi r2 છોડે.

Net rope shortening=2pi(r1−r2);બે supporting parts load rise share કરે.

Load rise per turn=pi(r1−r2),એટલે VR=2R/(r1−r2).

Supervised rated testમાં effort/load લો;designated holding system વાપરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

આ exampleમાં R200mm,r1=50mm,r2=40mm:VR40.Radius subscripts સ્પષ્ટ રાખો,ambiguous numbers નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

Turning a screw converts rotary input to axial load movement through its lead.

Construction:parts and purpose

A base/nut supports the threaded screw.

A screw and load cup transfer axial load.

A handle acts at effective radius R.

Thread leadl equals axial advance per screw revolution.

Working:sequence and reason

Position and support the rated jack according to approved instructions.

A handle revolution moves effort2piR and the screw/load byl.

UseVR=2piR/l; for a single-start thread only, l=pitch.

Operate/lower with the specified restraints and independent load supports.

Remember / avoid this mistake

R150 mm, lead5 mm gives VR188.496. A jack alone is not a support for working under a vehicle; multi-start screws require lead, not pitch.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Screw ફરતાં rotary input તેના lead પ્રમાણે axial load movementમાં ફેરવાય.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Base/nut threaded screwને support કરે.

Screw,load cup axial load આપે.

Handle effective radius R પર કામ કરે.

Thread lead l screwના એક revolutionનો axial advance છે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

Rated jackને approved instructions મુજબ position/support કરો.

Handle revolutionમાં effort2piR અને screw/load l જાય.

VR=2piR/l લો;single-startમાં જ l=pitch.

Specified restraints,independent load supports સાથે operate/lower કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

R150mm,lead5mm માટે VR188.496.Vehicle નીચે કામ કરવા jack એકલું support નથી;multi-startમાં lead જોઈએ,pitch નહિ.

body.en:
Definition

A worm drive reduces speed to the load drum; the worm start count determines the reduction.

Construction:parts and purpose

An input wheel/handle has effective radius R.

The worm hasns starts and drives a wheel withZ teeth.

The wheel shaft drives a load drum of radiusr.

Housing, bearings, rope and rated brake/holding system complete the arrangement.

Working:sequence and reason

One worm revolution advances the wheel byns/Z revolutions.

Effort travel per input turn=2piR.

Load rise per turn=2pir ns/Z; VR=(R/r)(Z/ns).

Use rated holding/lowering controls; verify back-driving rather than assume every worm is self-locking.

Remember / avoid this mistake

R200 mm, r50 mm, Z40, ns1 gives VR160; double-start ns2 gives VR80 for the same geometry.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Worm drive load drumની speed ઘટાડે;worm starts reduction નક્કી કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Input wheel/handleનો effective radius R છે.

Wormના ns starts,Z teethવાળા wheelને ચલાવે.

Wheel shaft radius rના load drumને ચલાવે.

Housing,bearings,rope,rated brake/holding system arrangement પૂરી કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

એક worm revolutionમાં wheel ns/Z revolution જાય.

Input turn દીઠ effort travel=2piR.

Load rise per turn=2pir ns/Z;VR=(R/r)(Z/ns).

Rated holding/lowering controls લો;દરેક worm self-locking માનવાને બદલે back-driving verify કરો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

R200mm,r50mm,Z40,ns1 માટે VR160;same geometryમાં double-start ns2 માટે VR80.

body.en:
Definition

A handle pinion drives one gear stage connected to a load drum.

Construction:parts and purpose

Handle radius R supplies input torque.

Input pinion hasz teeth; driven gear hasZ teeth.

Driven shaft carries a drum radiusr.

Frame, bearings, rope and rated brake/ratchet support the assembly.

Working:sequence and reason

One handle turn rotates the drum byz/Z turns.

Compare effort2piR with load rise2pir z/Z.

VR=(R/r)(Z/z).

EvaluateMA/efficiency from measured load and effort with the approved operating method.

Remember / avoid this mistake

R250 mm, r50 mm, z20, Z80 gives VR20. Do not invert driven/driver tooth ratio.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Handle pinion એક gear stageથી load drum ચલાવે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Handle radius R input torque આપે.

Input pinionના z,driven gearના Z teeth છે.

Driven shaft પર radius rનો drum હોય.

Frame,bearings,rope,rated brake/ratchet assemblyને ટેકો આપે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

એક handle turnમાં drum z/Z turns કરે.

Effort2piR અને load rise2pir z/Z સરખાવો.

VR=(R/r)(Z/z).

Approved methodમાં measured load,effortથી MA/efficiency લો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

R250mm,r50mm,z20,Z80 માટે VR20.Driven/driver tooth ratio ઊલટો ન લો.

body.en:
Definition

Two gear reductions multiply the ratio between handle and load drum.

Construction:parts and purpose

Input handle/pinion supplies the first drive.

First pinionz1 drives gearZ1 on an intermediate shaft.

Second pinionz2 on that shaft drives drum gearZ2.

Rated frame, drum, rope, brake and guards control/support the load.

Working:sequence and reason

First-stage speed ratio isz1/Z1.

Second-stage speed ratio isz2/Z2; drum turns multiply these.

VR=(R/r)(Z1/z1)(Z2/z2).

Determine effort/efficiency and safe holding by a supervised approved procedure.

Remember / avoid this mistake

R250 mm, r50 mm, ratios80/20 and60/15 giveVR80. More reduction does not eliminate friction or rated-load limits.
body.gu:
ચોક્કસ વ્યાખ્યા

Handle અને load drum વચ્ચે બે gear reductions ratio multiply કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને તેનું કામ

Input handle/pinion પહેલો drive આપે.

First pinion z1 intermediate shaftના gear Z1ને ચલાવે.

એ shaftનો second pinion z2 drum gear Z2 ચલાવે.

Rated frame,drum,rope,brake,guards load control/support કરે.

Working:ક્રમ અને કારણ

First-stage speed ratio z1/Z1 છે.

Second-stage ratio z2/Z2;drum turnsમાં બન્ને multiply થાય.

VR=(R/r)(Z1/z1)(Z2/z2).

Supervised approved procedureથી effort/efficiency,safe holding તપાસો.

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

R250mm,r50mm,ratios80/20,60/15 માટે VR80.વધુ reductionથી friction કે rated-load limits દૂર નથી થતી.

h.en: 7.1.12 Predicted effort from a measured efficiency

body.en:
Given

Single-purchase crab:VR20, load W2000 N, operating efficiency.60 at that load.

Stepwise solution

  1. MA=eta VR=.60×20=12
  2. P=W/MA=2000/12=166.667 N

Remember / avoid this mistake

Efficiency can change with load, condition and direction; do not transfer a single value across all operating points.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી

Single-purchase crab:VR20,load W2000N,તે load પર operating efficiency.60.

એક-એક પગલે ઉકેલ

  1. MA=eta VR=.60×20=12
  2. P=W/MA=2000/12=166.667N

યાદ રાખો / આ ભૂલ ટાળો

Efficiency load,condition,directionથી બદલાય;એક value બધા operating pointsમાં ન લો.

h.en: 7.1.13 Choose an eco-friendly AND safe machine
h.gu: 7.1.13 Eco-friendly અને Safe Machine પસંદ કરીએ

body.en:
Understand the reason

First match rated load, lift height, required holding/access and human effort; then compare total energy, friction, maintenance, service life, materials and lubricant/environment impacts.

A manual machine can suit an occasional small lift without electrical input; frequent heavy lifts may justify a more efficient powered system. Neither manual nor self-locking automatically means eco-friendly or safe.

Build an exam answer

  1. In an exam draw the layout, label input/load geometry, derive VR from one input turn, calculate MA/eta, then discuss reversibility, losses, safety and justified selection.
Quick check: DoesVR tell you actual effort without efficiency?

Only ideal effort W/VR; real effort needs actual MA or efficiency/law.
body.gu:
હવે કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

પહેલા rated load,lift height,holding/access,human effort match કરો;પછી total energy,friction,maintenance,service life,materials,lubricant/environment impacts સરખાવો.

ક્યારેકના નાના liftમાં manual machine electrical input વગર યોગ્ય બને;frequent heavy liftsમાં efficient powered system યોગ્ય હોઈ શકે.Manual કે self-locking એટલે આપમેળે eco-friendly/safe નહિ.

પરીક્ષામાં જવાબ ગોઠવીએ

  1. Examમાં layout દોરો,input/load geometry label કરો,એક input turnથી VR કાઢો,MA/eta ગણો,પછી reversibility,losses,safety,selection justify કરો.
જાતે વિચારો: Efficiency વગર VRથી Actual Effort મળે?

ફક્ત ideal effort W/VR મળે;real effort માટે actual MA કે efficiency/law જોઈએ.
